approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: A synthetic multipart/alternative email with two non-empty text/plain candidates currently merges both and manufactures a MIXED RFI role.
Reuse Python's standard email MIME tree and the existing safe text/HTML decoder; do not add a MIME library or mailbox connector.
Choose one supported candidate inside each alternative group, prefer non-empty plain text, and warn when same-type candidates conflict instead of merging them.
Attachment inventory still stops at attachment boundaries; 627 Python, 24 UI and 11 deploy tests passed with no attachment body entering evidence.
title: Select one MIME alternative body
objective: Prevent conflicting MIME alternatives from being merged into one Email/RFI/Submittal body while retaining safe fallback, attachment inventory and deterministic review warnings.
